entities.summary: Aaron Corthen, known as A.C. Reed, was an American blues saxophonist, closely associated with the Chicago blues scene from the 1940s into the 2000s. A.C. Reed was a composers & musicians from Wardell (1926-05-09, Wardell–2004-02-24). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
